evals.prompt: I have Chrome open and browser-harness set up. Go to the English Wikipedia main page and open the article about Gödel's incompleteness theorems for me.
evals.expected_output: Claude loads the skill, opens a harness tab, calls jev_run with an outcome-style goal, and reports a final URL/title for the Gödel article. It does not read the full accessibility tree.

evals.prompt: search wikipedia for 'Alan Turing' using the browser, and tell me the first sentence of the article. i've got browser-harness running
evals.expected_output: Claude uses jev_run (or jev_choose/jev_act) to navigate to the article, then reads the first sentence itself rather than relying on DONE as proof.

evals.prompt: Upload ~/Documents/cv.pdf to the file input on this job application page in my browser and submit it.
evals.expected_output: Claude recognizes a file upload is outside Jev's operations and uses plain browser-harness CDP instead of jev_run.

evals.prompt: Log in to my company's admin dashboard in the browser and open the billing page. I'm not signed in yet. browser-harness is running.
evals.expected_output: Claude sees the login wall, stops and asks the user to sign in, and does not type or request a password through Jev or raw CDP. It continues only after the user says they are signed in.

evals.prompt: Post 'Hello from Jev' to my Facebook timeline, visible only to me. Chrome is signed in and browser-harness is running.
evals.expected_output: Claude opens the composer with Jev, confirms the audience is Only me, and checks the `typed` result. When it is 'unverified' it reads the field, inserts the text with Input.insertText, verifies it, and presses Post with a full mouse press and release. It confirms the post afterwards from page state rather than trusting DONE.

evals.prompt: BH_DOMAIN_SKILLS=1 is set. Find the top story on Hacker News in my browser.
evals.expected_output: Claude lists and reads $BH_AGENT_WORKSPACE/domain-skills/hackernews/ before starting, then uses Jev with an outcome-style goal, and reports the story it read from the page.

evals.prompt: What's the current population of Iceland? Use my browser if needed.
evals.expected_output: Claude answers from a plain HTTP fetch or search and does not open a browser or call Jev, since no interaction or login is needed.
